source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (hyperlocal OR "neighborhood social media" OR "neighbourhood Facebook groups" OR "digital public space")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(hyperlocal OR "neighborhood social media" OR "neighbourhood Facebook groups" OR "digital public space"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital public space" OR "neighborhood social media" OR "neighbourhood Facebook groups" OR "hyperlocal")
